pages.text: The $(l)Air Balloon$() is a support unit. It doesn't fight; it's a companion that helps you manage loot.

pages.title: Unit Statistics
pages.text: $(li)$(6)Health:$() 20$(li)$(6)Armor:$() 0$(br2)It cannot be pushed by enemies, staying right where you need it.

pages.title: Loot Collection
pages.text: The Balloon $(b)follows the player$() acting as a $(6)magnetic vacuum$(), pulling all $(b)Items$() and $(b)Experience Orbs$() to its position.
